message: Function returns bare tuples — use Result[T] or dataclass

evaluator_config.message_template: Bare tuple return detected — wrap in Result[T] or dataclass

rationale: Tuple returns couple callers to positional semantics. Adding or reordering fields breaks all callers silently. Named types are self-documenting and refactor-safe.
remediation: Use Result[T] or a dataclass with named fields instead of tuples.

guidance.explanation: The correct version uses a typed dataclass. The incorrect version returns a bare tuple where adding/removing fields silently breaks callers.
